code: chunks are decompressed through frame_decompress_chunk(schunk->dctx, frame, nchunk, dest, nbytes)
note: Decompression dispatches into the frame path because the super-chunk has a frame.
Each requested chunk is materialized as a lazy chunk before decompression.
The chunk flags are attacker-controlled and decide whether the code treats the chunk as memcpyed or compressed.
For non-memcpyed chunks, block sizes are copied from the chunk header into a heap buffer.
The computed block sizes are copied into the lazy-chunk trailer; malformed sizes can drive invalid memory handling later.
If malformed metadata causes the lazy chunk allocation path to fail, the error path frees the chunk buffer.
